question: Where is the nearest hotel you’d find going toward Carl E. Johnson Lovers Key State Park, Fort Myers Beach, FL starting at South Venice Lemon Bay Preserve - South Entrance, Venice, FL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%South Venice Lemon Bay Preserve - South Entrance%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Carl E. Johnson Lovers Key State Park%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(ST_Centroid(s.geometry), ST_Centroid(e.geometry)) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM path_line)::geography, 10000) -- Hotels within 10km of the direct path ORDER BY p.geometry::geography <-> (SELECT geometry FROM start_point)::geography LIMIT 1;
